_comment: Cedar test cases for the optio pack (M4-4).
Consumed by tests/policy/test_policy_packs.py, which runs the real `cedar`
CLI when it is installed and otherwise validates structure. Each case is a
full authorization request plus the decision it must produce.
The absence cases are the load-bearing ones: they prove an omitted signal
is treated as unknown rather than as zero or as an error. See ADR-004.

cases.name: projected cost over the ceiling is denied
cost exactly at the ceiling is allowed
repeating is allowed - healthy agents repeat
low groundedness is denied when the quality lane is on
quality lane off does not deny
absent cost signal does not deny
absent budget does not deny - most runs have no budget policy
no signals at all does not deny - this is a fail-open activation
